message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and the quality commitment is where that starts. Our options put it at the centre and take the chargeback off the table.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 36.75.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.08.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 37.31.

Option A is the package we can approve. It asks for a tighter quality commitment than your offer, and the price reflects what the bracket has cost us in the past, not a premium for defects that no longer carry a chargeback.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Options B and C are there if you prefer to commit to an even tighter quality level.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Sure, energy dropped a tiny bit, but our other costs are still high. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our current offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. As an option, I can give you a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint, but we need to talk about faster payment. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
